decision: Announced identity-only successor for the HPC memory/thread review (PR397), following the merged PR395 identity: bit-identical performance and memory changes to the ridge/KRR Cholesky, histgbm, histgbm2, ksmooth, the op epilogue, the stage cache and the GP token accounting, plus lint-only feat-math edits. Every behaviour fixture (stage values, serialized models, emitted bytes, seeded generator streams and search runs) is unchanged; DSL ABI, Cargo.lock, lineage source lists and accepted historical identities are unchanged. This record replaces the branch's earlier, never-merged records minted from ca6e15f (identity 16eba4ea2ff66318...) and from 45490f2 (629c92424b78c922...); both stay in the PR branch history.
lineage_effect: Only generated_at_sha refreshed by the owning identity mode; all lineage source lists and hashes unchanged. Rebuilt executables mint their own runtime identities, as for every engine change.

other_runtime_source_identities.identity: feat-math numeric_v2_emit::numeric_source_hash (numeric_v2.rs, heads.rs, ops.rs, stack.rs, rng.rs)
other_runtime_source_identities.effect: FittedArtifactV2::reload refuses numeric-fitted-artifact-v2 artifacts emitted at base_commit (numeric source identity mismatch); re-emit them from the same model. No such artifact or digest is pinned in the tree.

other_runtime_source_identities.identity: jope-pipeline search_events::source_sha256 (search.rs, search_events.rs, feat-math evolve.rs, jope-records wire_contract.rs)
other_runtime_source_identities.effect: search_recorder refuses a caller SearchBinding made at base_commit; existing event logs keep their recorded source identity. No digest is pinned in the tree.
